Stillinlove emphasises continuing feeling toward anoldgirlfriend,without establishing reciprocation or equating hisage with timeapart.

Noboredombutcuriosity gives the authors reading of a literarycase:onewoman and old/newappeal,not a measuredneed to replace familiarpeople. The question on genuinemeaning doesnot present the adjective as an experimental authenticitytest.

The proverb is said to be popularinJapan,not exclusivelyJapaneseinorigin. Its charactermeanings are kept warm/old/knowledge/new in sourceorder. Characterhere means writtensymbol,not fictionalperson. The listedmusiciansandartists embraceexperiment,newstyles,anddevelopmentovertime;they are not described as having identicalmedia/outputcounts. Deeperlongtermengagement with familiarwork is the route to learning,not simply countingnames or waiting fornewreleases.
